targets: Lumbar flexion mobility; gluteal and hip extensor flexibility

summary.en: Lying on your back, hug one knee gently towards your chest while the other foot stays on the bed.
summary.ru: Peeth ke bal let kar ek ghutne ko aahista seene ki taraf kheinchein, doosra paon bed par rahe.

indications: Low back stiffness, especially in the morning
contraindications: Pain or numbness spreading down the leg when flexed
Recent disc injury if flexion is aggravating

safety.en: Pull only to a gentle stretch. Stop if pain travels down your leg.
safety.ru: Sirf halke stretch tak kheinchein. Agar dard taang mein neeche utray to ruk jayein.

setup.en: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat.
setup.ru: Peeth ke bal let jayein, dono ghutne mude hue aur paon sapaat.

steps.en: Slowly bring one knee towards your chest, holding behind the thigh.
steps.ru: Aahista ek ghutne ko seene ki taraf layein, thigh ke peeche se pakar kar.

steps.en: Keep your lower back resting on the bed and your shoulders relaxed.
steps.ru: Kamar bed par tiki rahe aur kandhe dheele rahein.

steps.en: Hold the stretch, then lower the foot back to the bed.
steps.ru: Stretch ko hold karein, phir paon wapis bed par rakh dein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you pull the knee in; breathe normally during the hold.
breathing.ru: Ghutna andar late waqt saans bahar; hold mein normal saans.

mistakes.en: Lifting the head and shoulders off the bed
mistakes.ru: Sar aur kandhe bed se uthana
Dard ke bawajood zor se kheinchna

regressions: Hold behind the knee instead of the shin

say.en: Hug the knee in gently — only to a comfortable stretch.
say.ru: Ghutne ko aahista andar layein — sirf aaram dah stretch tak.

name.ru: Kamar ki rotation (ghutne side par girana)

targets: Lumbar and lumbopelvic rotation mobility; trunk rotators

summary.en: With knees bent, let both knees fall slowly to one side and then the other, keeping the shoulders flat.
summary.ru: Ghutne mude hue, dono ghutne aahista ek side par girayein, phir doosri side par — kandhe bed par rahein.

contraindications: Pain that spreads into the leg on rotation

safety.en: Move only as far as is comfortable — small is fine.
safety.ru: Sirf utna harkat karein jitna aaram se ho — chhoti harkat bhi theek hai.

setup.en: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet together and flat, arms out to the sides.
setup.ru: Peeth ke bal let jayein, ghutne mude hue, paon jore hue aur sapaat, bazu side mein phailaye hue.

steps.en: Keep both shoulders on the bed.
steps.ru: Dono kandhe bed par rakhein.

steps.en: Slowly let both knees drop to one side as far as is comfortable.
steps.ru: Aahista dono ghutne ek taraf jitna aaram se ho girne dein.

steps.en: Bring them back to the middle, then repeat to the other side.
steps.ru: Wapis darmiyan mein layein, phir doosri taraf dohrayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as the knees lower; breathe in as they return.
breathing.ru: Ghutne girate waqt saans bahar, wapis aate waqt andar.

progressions: Legs straighter for a bigger stretch
regressions: Place a pillow between the knees

say.en: Let both knees fall slowly to the side.
say.ru: Dono ghutne aahista side par girne dein.

targets: Gluteus maximus, hamstrings and trunk extensors; lumbopelvic control

summary.en: Lying on your back with knees bent, squeeze the buttocks and lift the hips until shoulders, hips and knees are in a line.
summary.ru: Ghutne mude hue peeth ke bal letkar kulhe tight karein aur kulhe itna uthayein ke kandhe, kulhe aur ghutne ek line mein aa jayein.

indications: Low back pain with poor hip control
contraindications: Pain in the back or hamstring cramping that does not ease with a smaller lift
Recent abdominal or spinal surgery unless cleared

safety.en: Lift only until your body is in a straight line — do not arch the back.
safety.ru: Sirf utna uthayein ke jism seedhi line mein aa jaye — kamar ko arch na karein.

setup.en: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart, arms by your sides.
setup.ru: Peeth ke bal let jayein, ghutne mude hue, paon sapaat aur kulhon ki chorai tak khule, bazu side mein.

steps.en: Gently tighten your lower tummy muscles.
steps.ru: Neeche ke pait ke muscles halke se tight karein.

steps.en: Squeeze the buttocks and push through your heels to lift the hips.
steps.ru: Kulhe tight karein aur aerhiyon se zor laga kar kulhe uthayein.

steps.en: Stop when shoulders, hips and knees make a straight line; hold.
steps.ru: Jab kandhe, kulhe aur ghutne seedhi line mein ho jayein to ruk kar hold karein.

steps.en: Lower slowly, one bone at a time.
steps.ru: Aahista neeche aayein, ek ek mohra karke.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you lift; keep breathing steadily in the hold.
breathing.ru: Uthate waqt saans bahar; hold mein saans lete rahein.

mistakes.en: Arching the lower back at the top
mistakes.ru: Upar jaakar kamar ko arch karna
Ghutne bahar ya andar ki taraf girna

mistakes.en: Pushing through the toes instead of the heels
mistakes.ru: Aerhiyon ki jagah panjon se zor lagana

dosage.frequency: Once a day or every second day

progressions: Bridge with a band above the knees

say.en: Squeeze and lift until you make a straight line.
say.ru: Kulhe tight karke uthayein jab tak seedhi line na ban jaye.

text.en: Mistake: arching the lower back instead of using the buttocks.
text.ru: Ghalti: kulhon ki jagah kamar ko arch karna.

targets: Gluteus maximus and hamstrings of the working leg; pelvic control (gluteus medius, trunk stabilisers)

summary.en: Lift one leg and bridge up on the other, keeping the pelvis level.
summary.ru: Ek taang uthayein aur doosri taang par bridge banayein, pelvis barabar rakhein.

contraindications: Cannot yet do 10 controlled double-leg bridges
Hamstring cramping or back pain with the lift

safety.en: Keep the hips level — if the pelvis drops, go back to the two-leg bridge.
safety.ru: Kulhe barabar rakhein — agar pelvis gir jaye to do taangon wale bridge par wapis jayein.

setup.en: Lie on your back, knees bent. Lift one foot off the bed, knee bent.
setup.ru: Peeth ke bal let jayein, ghutne mude hue. Ek paon bed se utha lein, ghutna mura hua.

steps.en: Push through the heel of the foot on the bed and lift the hips.
steps.ru: Bed par rakhe paon ki aerhi se zor laga kar kulhe uthayein.

steps.en: Keep both hip bones level and hold.
steps.ru: Kulhon ki dono haddiyan barabar rakhein aur hold karein.

steps.en: Lower slowly and repeat before changing sides.
steps.ru: Aahista neeche aayein aur side badalne se pehle dohrayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out on the lift; breathe steadily during the hold.
breathing.ru: Uthate waqt saans bahar; hold mein saans lete rahein.

mistakes.ru: Pelvis ka gir jana ya mur jana

progressions: Add a light weight on the hips

say.en: Lift on one leg and keep your hips level.
say.ru: Ek taang par uthayein aur kulhe barabar rakhein.

targets: Deep abdominals (transversus abdominis), obliques and hip flexors; lumbopelvic control

summary.en: Lying on your back with knees and arms up, lower the opposite arm and leg slowly while keeping the lower back still.
summary.ru: Peeth ke bal let kar ghutne aur bazu upar rakhein, phir ulte bazu aur taang ko aahista neeche layein, kamar sakit rahe.

indications: Core stability for low back pain
contraindications: Back pain that increases during the movement
Pregnancy (second and third trimester) — use an alternative position

safety.en: Stop if your lower back lifts off the bed — reduce the range.
safety.ru: Agar kamar bed se uthne lage to ruk jayein — range kam karein.

setup.en: Lie on your back, hips and knees bent to 90°, arms pointing to the ceiling.
setup.ru: Peeth ke bal let jayein, kulhe aur ghutne 90° par mude hue, bazu chhat ki taraf.

steps.en: Brace gently so your lower back stays in contact with the bed.
steps.ru: Halke se pait tight karein taa ke kamar bed se lagi rahe.

steps.en: Slowly lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg towards the bed.
steps.ru: Aahista ek bazu sar ke upar aur ulti taang bed ki taraf layein.

steps.en: Return to the start and repeat on the other side.
steps.ru: Wapis shuru ki position par aayein aur doosri side dohrayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as the arm and leg lower; in as they return.
breathing.ru: Bazu aur taang neeche late waqt saans bahar; wapis aate waqt andar.

mistakes.en: Lower back arching away from the bed
mistakes.ru: Kamar ka bed se uth jana

say.en: Lower the opposite arm and leg — keep your back still.
say.ru: Ulta bazu aur taang neeche layein — kamar sakit rakhein.

targets: Trunk extensors (multifidus, erector spinae), gluteals and deltoid; anti-rotation control

summary.en: On hands and knees, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back while keeping the trunk steady.
summary.ru: Haath aur ghutno par aakar ek bazu aage aur ulti taang peeche barhayein, jism seedha aur sakit rahe.

indications: Low back pain with poor trunk control
contraindications: Wrist or knee pain on weight-bearing (use padding or another exercise)
Pain in the back that increases with the reach

safety.en: Move slowly. Do not let your back sag or twist.
safety.ru: Aahista harkat karein. Kamar ko jhukne ya mudne na dein.

setup.en: On hands and knees: hands under shoulders, knees under hips, back flat.
setup.ru: Haath aur ghutno par aayein: haath kandhon ke neeche, ghutne kulhon ke neeche, kamar sapaat.

steps.en: Brace your tummy lightly and keep your neck in line with your spine.
steps.ru: Pait halka tight karein aur gardan ko reerh ki seedh mein rakhein.

steps.en: Slide one leg straight back and reach the opposite arm forward.
steps.ru: Ek taang seedhi peeche sarkayein aur ulta bazu aage barhayein.

steps.en: Hold for the count with your hips level, then return slowly.
steps.ru: Kulhe barabar rakh kar count tak hold karein, phir aahista wapis aayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you reach; keep breathing during the hold.
breathing.ru: Barhate waqt saans bahar; hold mein saans lete rahein.

mistakes.ru: Kamar ka jhuk jana ya mur jana

mistakes.en: Lifting the leg too high and arching
mistakes.ru: Taang zyada uthana aur kamar arch karna
Wazan ek side se doosri par dalna

say.en: Reach the arm forward and the opposite leg back, hips level.
say.ru: Bazu aage aur ulti taang peeche barhayein, kulhe barabar.

text.en: Mistake: the back sags and the hips twist.
text.ru: Ghalti: kamar jhuk jati hai aur kulhe mur jate hain.

targets: Trunk endurance — rectus abdominis, obliques, transversus abdominis, gluteals and shoulder stabilisers

summary.en: Hold a straight body line on your forearms and toes, keeping the tummy gently braced.
summary.ru: Forearms aur panjon par seedhi line mein jism ko hold karein, pait halka tight rahe.

indications: Trunk endurance after basic core training
Progression for low back pain management
contraindications: Shoulder, wrist or back pain on loading

safety.en: Stop when your hips sag or your back aches — quality before time.
safety.ru: Jab kulhe jhukne lagein ya kamar dard kare to ruk jayein — waqt se pehle sahi form.

setup.en: Lie face down, forearms on the mat with elbows under shoulders, toes tucked.
setup.ru: Munh neeche letkar forearms mat par rakhein, kohniyan kandhon ke neeche, panjay mude hue.

steps.en: Push up so your body is a straight line from head to heels.
steps.ru: Upar uthein taa ke sar se aerhi tak jism seedhi line mein ho.

steps.en: Brace your tummy and squeeze the buttocks lightly.
steps.ru: Pait tight karein aur kulhe halke se tight karein.

steps.en: Hold for the time, then lower with control.
steps.ru: Waqt tak hold karein, phir control se neeche aayein.

breathing.en: Breathe steadily in and out — never hold your breath.
breathing.ru: Saans barabar lete rahein — kabhi saans na rokein.

mistakes.en: Looking up and straining the neck
mistakes.ru: Upar dekh kar gardan par zor dalna

say.en: Lift your knees off the mat and hold a straight line from head to heels.
say.ru: Ghutne mat se uthayein aur sar se aerhi tak seedhi line mein hold karein.
